airlock.name: Airlock
airlock.description: A cold, metallic airlock. The shuttle door is sealed behind you.

main_corridor.name: Main Corridor
main_corridor.description: The central artery of the station. Red emergency lights are flashing.

crew_quarters.name: Crew Quarters
crew_quarters.description: Unmade beds and belongings scattered in a hurry.

cafeteria.name: Cafeteria
cafeteria.description: Overturned meal trays on the tables. An atmosphere of frozen panic.

medbay.name: Medbay
medbay.description: Secured area. The surgical equipment is still powered on.

armory.name: Armory
armory.description: The weapon racks have been completely stripped.

maintenance_bay.name: Maintenance Bay
maintenance_bay.description: A room filled with live wires and heavy tools. A security screen blinks on the wall.

ai_core.name: AI Core
ai_core.description: A vast room dominated by a monolith of humming servers. The heart of Prometheus Station.

energy_cell.name: Energy Cell
energy_cell.description: A compact battery crackling with energy.

medkit.name: Emergency Medkit
medkit.description: A sealed field medical kit, standard station issue.

central_generator.name: Central Generator
central_generator.description: Heavy equipment welded to the floor.

sec_drone.name: Security Drone
sec_drone.description: An armed automaton with failing sensors.

injured_engineer.name: Injured Engineer
injured_engineer.description: A technician leaning against the wall, clutching a bleeding side.
dialogue: I need an energy cell to activate the stasis pod.

ai_terminal.name: AI Terminal
ai_terminal.description: A screen displaying a static red eye.
dialogue: Disable the Alpha Drone to restore my containment protocols.

cleaning_bot.name: Cleaning Bot
cleaning_bot.description: A small automated vacuum moving aimlessly around the debris.

core_mainframe.name: Core Mainframe
core_mainframe.description: The pulsing central processor of Prometheus.
dialogue: Lockdown lifted. You are authorized to access the escape shuttles. Well done.
